inclusions.text: Private vehicle, exclusive to your party
inclusions.source: The vehicle is private, exclusive to your party, the driver is yours alone, and the pace is largely your own.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: It takes bookings from a single traveller upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.

inclusions.text: Pick-up from your hotel in Aswan or the Aswan cruise terminal
inclusions.source: Departure is from your hotel in Aswan, or from the Aswan cruise terminal if you are joining the transfer from a boat.

inclusions.text: Drop-off at your chosen destination in Luxor (hotel, cruise ship berth, or the airport)
inclusions.source: Arrival at your chosen destination in Luxor — hotel, cruise ship berth, or the airport — completes the transfer.

exclusions.source: Entrance fees to both sites are not included in the transfer price and are paid on arrival in Egyptian pounds.

An Egyptologist guide, available as an optional add-on, will make significantly more sense of what you are looking at — particularly at Edfu, where the mythological texts on the walls are among the most complete surviving accounts of the Horus cycle.
